# PulseRN website release checklist

Use this checklist in the website pull request for every PulseRN release.

- [ ] Update installation instructions in this repository and `maahibhama/PulseRN`.
- [ ] Update SDK setup and public API documentation in both repositories.
- [ ] Update supported operating system and React Native compatibility information.
- [ ] Confirm the release provides every required desktop artifact and checksum.
- [ ] Test every download link against the published GitHub release.
- [ ] Update the release notes and roadmap.
- [ ] Run `pnpm validate`.
- [ ] Verify the preview on mobile and desktop, including keyboard navigation.
- [ ] After merge, verify the production Pages deployment and nested-route refreshes.
